result.reason: The clause reaches only the fallback 90-day conformity period for Deliverables. It does not expressly cover services for 30 days, require professional and workmanlike performance, provide repair/replacement/refund remedies, require legal compliance, or prohibit malicious code. References to unspecified sections and preservation of other remedies do not supply those operative protections. Adding acceptance criteria and broad claim-limitation language goes beyond the minimum stated change, and the duplicated “19.2” is a drafting error.
